name: GPUI Kit
summary: Rust UI framework and component library with 75+ components for building GPUI desktop apps.
description: GPUI Kit is a Rust desktop application framework built on GPUI. It documents 75+ components and primitives across basic, form, layout and advanced groups — buttons, dialogs, forms, data tables, charts, docking layouts, a command palette and a code editor — plus accessibility, WebAssembly support and UI integration testing, and ships as Cargo crates (gpui-kit, gpui-base, gpui-component).
contains: component groups: basic, form, layout, advanced
docking layouts with tabs, splits and persistent state
data tables, charts (line, bar, area, pie, candlestick, radar, sankey) and a source-code editor
WebAssembly, accessibility, UI integration testing and JavaScript extensions
design guides, coding guides and skills for agents
16.9k GitHub stars; Apache-2.0; macOS, Windows, Linux, WebAssembly
